text:
Olivia: Hey infra team — requesting quota increases across multiple GCP projects for an upcoming model rollout. TL;DR: need A100-80GB in us-central1 (24 GPUs), H100 in europe-west4 (12 GPUs), and L4 in asia-southeast1 (40 GPUs). Also need static egress IPs for the L4 pool, Shared VPC host project entitlement, and VPC peering allowances for cross-project traffic.

Sam: Which projects + billing accounts? will finance sign off?

Olivia: Projects & billing:
- redwood-prod-ml-us (billing: BA-PRD-001) — A100 pool 24, dedicated
- redwood-eu-models (billing: BA-PRD-002) — H100 12, burst-capable
- redwood-ap-inference (billing: BA-SAT-003) — L4 40, ephemeral burst

Michael: Need rough cost estimate before I sign off. Put numbers please.

Olivia: Rough on-demand estimates (cloud list prices, pre-discount):
- A100-80GB ~ $5.0/hr -> 24 * 5 * 24 * 30 ≈ $86k/mo (peak-sized capacity)
- H100 ~ $9.0/hr -> 12 * 9 * 8 * 30 ≈ $25.9k/mo (we'll only run partial hours outside peak)
- L4 ~ $1.2/hr -> 40 * 1.2 * 6 * 30 ≈ $8.6k/mo (ephemeral inference)
Note: we'll use sustained committed reserved capacity for A100s (discounts) and autoscale for others. These are conservative top-line numbers for approval.

Kate: For Shared VPC host project: confirm host project id and make sure the quota increase is requested in the host project (not service projects). Also we need the service account that will create instances. Provide SA email and the static IP requests for L4.

Olivia: Host project: redwood-shared-host-001. SA: compute-sa@redwood-prod-ml-us. Static IPs needed: 8 external static IPs in asia-southeast1 for the L4 pool (NAT egress for partner whitelists). We'll request them in the same support case.

oncall-bot: Checklist: 1) Billing account linked, 2) Shared VPC host project identified, 3) Service account with compute admin, 4) Expected delta per region, 5) Static external IP count, 6) Expected burst windows. Attach quota spreadsheet when filing.

Ryan: Can we make A100s dedicated capacity? noisy-neighbor risk otherwise.

Olivia: Yes planning dedicated pool in us-central1 for A100s. Will mark quota request as "reserved/dedicated" in the ticket and note SLA requirement.

Jen: Security question: will these projects use customer-managed KMS keys or platform-managed? Also any VPC-SC restrictions for EU project?

Olivia: redwood-prod-ml-us will use platform KMS for now; redwood-eu-models will use customer-managed keys (KMS) — I'll add IAM roles to the SA. No VPC-SC currently but we'll check with legal before enabling cross-project peering.

Alex: For model sizing: A100-80GB is required for the 70B mix; we might reduce A100 count if we shard across model variants — but prefer reserve the 24 now and trim later.

Sam: Kate, can you confirm GCP support form links and if we should request via console or support ticket API?

Kate: Please open a case via Cloud Support with quota increase type. Attach spreadsheet with columns: project, region, metric (GPUS), current, requested, justification, billing account. Include host project and SA. You can also request static IPs in the same case. Example ticket description I've used below.

Olivia: Example support case body (copy/paste):
```
Project: redwood-shared-host-001 (host project)
Projects affected: redwood-prod-ml-us, redwood-eu-models, redwood-ap-inference
Regions: us-central1 (A100-80GB) request +24, europe-west4 (H100) +12, asia-southeast1 (L4) +40
Static external IPs: asia-southeast1: 8
Billing accounts: BA-PRD-001, BA-PRD-002, BA-SAT-003
Justification: Production inference rollout for high-throughput LLM serving. Dedicated pool for A100s, burst pools for H100/L4. We require assurances on regional availability and quota allocation to the host project. Contact: olivia@redwood.ai
```

Sam: I'll double-check IAM for compute-sa and attach the spreadsheet.

Michael: OK from finance in principle, but submit the exact committed usage plan for A100 reserved capacity before final signoff. We prefer a 12-month commitment if traffic stabilizes.

Olivia: Understood. Filing case now and will paste support case link here.

Kate: Also open a separate request for external IP quota and EIP reservation if your networking team needs them bound to a NAT gateway.

Olivia: Filed support case: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/CASE-2026-00012345 (I'll update with ticket activity). Thanks all.

Alex: Thanks — I'll start preparing rollout tests once we get informal approval.

Olivia: Will track in infra-requests board and update with final quota approvals. :thumbsup:
